dung01_puzzle08.name: Ode of Bombardment
dung01_puzzle08.desc:
An extremely unstable Protocol Space. Expect the unexpected. 
"You call this a rain of shells? Pfft. This is a mere spittle from an ordinary artillery battery. It's nothing compared to the nightmares of battlefields from the past."
dung01_puzzle08.featureDesc: Dodge the Aggeloid bombardment and reach the exit.
